messages:
emma-peopleops: Hi team, just flagging — I got paid today and my net pay is negative. Looks like my 401k pretax got applied twice and state withholding is showing CA even though I filed NY mid-month move. Can someone confirm?
raja-engr: whoa negative pay, ouch. did you see the paystub details? can you paste the lines?
emma-peopleops: pasted snippet below from payroll PDF:
```
Gross Pay: $4,200.00
Pre-tax 401k: -$420.00
Pre-tax 401k: -$420.00  <-- duplicate line
Federal Tax: -$520.00
State Tax (CA): -$680.00
Net Pay: -$240.00
```
lena-hr: @emma-peopleops sorry about this. we have your state change recorded effective 2026-02-18 in Workday, did payroll run after that date?
emma-peopleops: payroll run date is 2026-02-20 per pay period. I updated address 2/18 so it should have been NY withholding (I live in NY now).
payroll-bot: Payroll run 2026-02-20 completed for pay-period 02/01-02/20. Processing notices: 1) Manual adjustments flagged, 2) 401k contributions imported from benefits feed.
nash: :eyes: (sorry jumping in)
nash: sounds like benefits feed sent duplicate 401k record. can hook into benefits ops to check import job.
nash: also double-check if new hire/transfer code set contributed twice during manual override window.
emma-peopleops: I need to know if this will be resolved before direct deposit reversal hits negative bank balance. Any temporary fix?
nash: payroll can issue an emergency off-cycle reversal or manual ACH for net pay. @ashley-payroll will advise SLA.
nash: also, we should avoid immediate reversal if it's a withholding mismatch that requires W-2 corrections later.
nash: tagging payroll.
nash: @ashley-payroll please advise on off-cycle and W-2 implications.
nash: cc @lena-hr for residency confirmation.
nash: :handshake:
ashley-payroll: Sorry for the trouble, @emma-peopleops. We can process an off-cycle correction today to fix the duplicate 401k contribution and correct state withholding to NY for this pay period. Off-cycle timeline: same-day adjustment if submitted by 11:00 PT, otherwise next business day.
nashley-payroll: Regarding W-2: If the pay period ended in 2026 and the correction is in the same tax year, we'll file W-2 with correct year-to-date wages; if an original W-2 is already issued we will prepare a W-2c. We'll keep docs for audit.
nashley-payroll: To proceed I need: 1) a screenshot of your Workday address change confirmation, 2) the paystub page you pasted, and 3) confirmation you want an immediate off-cycle ACH credit.
emma-peopleops: Uploaded the Workday confirmation and PDF in the thread. Please proceed with immediate off-cycle ACH credit.
nashley-payroll: Received. Starting off-cycle now. I'll update once processed. ETA 2 hours.
nashley-payroll: Also opening a ticket with benefits ops to dedupe the 401k feed to prevent recurrence.
lena-hr: Thanks, payroll. @emma-peopleops we'll also verify state resident date for tax allocation and if any reciprocal credits apply.
nashley-payroll: Update: Off-cycle processed at 1723456820. Net refund of $1,040.00 ACH to employee bank initiated. Please allow standard bank settlement time for posting. Reference: PAY-OF-8342.
nashley-payroll: Update: Benefits-team fixed import rule; duplicate record caused by TTL on the import queue. Root cause ticket BT-992.
nashley-payroll: We'll adjust withholding records so your year-to-date state tax is reallocated to NY. If you need a W-2c later, we'll prepare it — but current plan is to issue corrected W-2 at year-end if additional corrections are required.
nashley-payroll: Anything else we should handle here?
nashley-payroll: :white_check_mark:
emma-peopleops: Thank you everyone — refund posted this afternoon, all good on my side. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
lena-hr: Noted for residency audit. I'll close with you once I confirm the effective date and update the payroll audit doc.
payroll-bot: Ticket PAY-OF-8342 closed. BT-992 assigned to benefits-ops.
raja-engr: wild, glad that cleared up. thanks team :tada:
